bio: Mary Elizabeth Keating was born at Larksville, Pa., in March 1862. In 1880 she was living at Avondale in the household of John F. Connole. She died at Plymouth, Pa., on 14 June 1914 and was buried in St. Vincent de Paul Cemetery, Larksville.
